mapper.insert: insert into xl_user_experience (user_id, target_type, target_id, content, title, tags, ai_verified, create_time) values (#{userId}, #{targetType}, #{targetId}, #{content}, #{title}, #{tags}, 0, now())
mapper.select: select id, user_id, target_type, target_id, content, title, tags, ai_verified, ai_score, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, remark from xl_user_experience where id = #{id}

select id, user_id, target_type, target_id, content, title, tags, ai_verified, ai_score, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, remark from xl_user_experience where target_type = #{targetType} and target_id = #{targetId} and ai_verified = 1 order by create_time desc

select e.id, e.user_id as userId, e.target_type as targetType, e.target_id as targetId, e.content, e.title, e.tags, e.create_time as createTime, u.nickname as nickname, d.name as destinationName from xl_user_experience e left join xl_travel_user u on e.user_id = u.id left join xl_destination d on e.target_type = 'destination' and e.target_id = d.id where e.target_type = 'destination' and e.ai_verified = 1 and e.target_id = #{destinationId} and (e.tags like concat('%', #{tag}, '%')) order by e.create_time desc
mapper.update: update xl_user_experience set ai_verified = #{aiVerified}, ai_score = #{aiScore}, update_time = now() where id = #{id}
